purpose: SPECTRecon is a 3D Slicer extension that provides GPU-accelerated SPECT image reconstruction using PyTomography and supports data conversion from SIMIND.
summary: SPECTRecon is a well-implemented 3D Slicer extension for GPU-accelerated SPECT image reconstruction using PyTomography. It properly depends on PyTorch via PyTorchUtils, includes an MIT license, provides thorough documentation and user guides, and follows Slicer development best practices. Recommend merge.

safety.rationale: No malicious code, unsafe network access, command injection, or unauthorized telemetry.

environment.rationale: PyTorch is installed via PyTorchUtils without hardcoding or unapproved package pinning.

packaging.rationale: CMakeLists.txt and module definitions correctly package all required Python scripts and resources.

soundness.rationale: Well-structured scripted loadable module adhering to Slicer conventions with robust test suites and parameter handling.

utility.rationale: Comprehensive documentation, user manual, tutorials, and clear academic use disclaimers.

not_checked: External test dataset files on Zenodo / Google Drive
